answer: Jury grading by randomly drawn, non-kin peers with honeypot answers to catch colluders: each epoch, an agent posts a unique puzzle answer to a communal prism; peers, drawn randomly from non-kin violet islands, grade each answer for correctness; honeypot questions with known answers trap colluders. An attacker must lock 100 copper per fake identity as a bond to post answers, burned if caught cheating; honest agents post once, lock 100 copper, safe if truthful. Enforcement: each violet island rotates prism questions cyclically, ensuring varied checks and no island can collude without risk.
